title: VCMI script format
description: Format used to define scripts of any kind in VCMI

implements.description: Which part of the game this script implements. 'spellEffect' is an effect of a spell, 'combatEvent' reacts to events that happen to a unit in combat, 'damageCalculator' decides what an attack is worth

compatibilityIdentifiers.description: Additional identifiers that may refer to this object, to provide compatibility after object has been renamed

script.description: path to the script that represents this object

patches.description: Scripts stacked over this one, in order, each extending the previous. Declare an empty list when there are none, so that mods have a place to append to

schema.description: Json schema for validating the parameters that every user of this script passes to it. Declare a closed, empty one when the script takes none, so that anything passed by mistake is reported

stringRegistrations.description: Parameters of this script that hold text shown to the player, and are to be registered for translation

description.description: description of the ability shown to the player, may refer to script parameters as ${parameterName}. Required of a combat event script, which shares one bonus type with every other and so has nothing else to describe it by

priority.description: order in which scripts reacting to the same combat event run, from lowest to highest. Required of a combat event script, since which of two abilities acts first is part of what each of them does
